experience.home: full Psychology curriculum + bookshelf + integrated month/week/agenda + visual course covers
experience.course: cover-led course interior with Programa / Clases / Parciales / Materiales + course-specific historical archive when verified
experience.assessment: course-scoped Study System V2 instance rendered inside Study Library
experience.source_policy: Blackboard is a subordinate source layer; technical panel is hidden from normal UX

performance.first_feedback: inline loading shell is paintable before Supabase and application JavaScript

lazy_execution.class_v13_v14: only before entering/direct-opening a class session
lazy_execution.blackboard_content_v9: after course navigation; no duplicate Blackboard content fetch on library boot
lazy_execution.covers_v16: only near viewport; first/second year may warm sequentially during idle time

idle_execution: V12 knowledge so the complete curriculum appears without blocking first paint
V16 cover warming with low concurrency and save-data opt-out
performance.operation_feedback: subtle delayed indicator after 180 ms for course, class, assessment and whiteboard operations
performance.preservation_rule: historical compatibility layers remain available; V15/V16 change scheduling and enrichment, not feature authority

course_enrichment.cover_delivery: lazy remote resolve -> persistent IndexedDB blob cache; existing two-color cover is immediate no-text fallback
course_enrichment.historical_archive_policy: course-specific folder only; universal root is never surfaced to student UI
course_enrichment.legacy_warning: historical material can reflect previous programs and must be checked against current program/current sources

blackboard.verified_baseline: 0.3.0 completed first real Windows/Firefox ingest on 2026-09-11
blackboard.v0_4_state: code staged; requires Firefox temporary-addon reload/install before browser validation
blackboard.file_mirror: diagnostics added; not closed until a v0.4 browser sync proves mirrored files

study_system.integration_rule: exam-specific content is data; Study Library owns subject/course navigation; generic Study System owns theory, recall, practice, progress and per-topic whiteboard

transcription.live: browser SpeechRecognition es-AR; provisional only; never canonical
transcription.reconciliation: fuzzy overlap alignment; exact word equality is not authoritative
transcription.persisted_transcript: uses the same fuzzy canonical merge as the visible transcript
transcription.failure_policy: reject suspicious transcript and preserve original audio for retry
transcription.master_recovery: rebuildable from IndexedDB master slices via PrometeoTranscriptionV14.rebuildMaster(sessionId)

whiteboard.preview: source-rendered WB10 thumbnail; preview is derivative, never canonical
whiteboard.concurrency: whole-state/revision; do not claim per-stroke CRDT

preserve: Modelos II P1 detailed reference surface
